## What changed

Describe the user outcome and the product boundary affected.

## Verification

- [ ] Type checking passes.
- [ ] Production build passes.
- [ ] No secrets, private procurement records, or sensitive evidence are included.
- [ ] New capability claims match the implementation plan's honest boundary.

## Public story and brand review

Complete this section when the change touches the landing page, public documentation, product film, social preview, logo, typography, palette, icons, affiliation marks, or conversion copy.

- [ ] The change follows `docs/BRAND_SYSTEM.md`.
- [ ] The ten-second promise and ninety-second tender-to-proof journey remain clear.
- [ ] Traceli's trace-node lockup, typography, palette, and product-glyph grammar remain consistent.
- [ ] External marks remain monochrome, subordinate, optically balanced, and paired with the required non-endorsement qualifier.
- [ ] Every displayed affiliation mark has an up-to-date decision in `docs/AFFILIATION_REGISTER.md`.
- [ ] Fictional, staged, sanitized, planned, or unavailable behavior is labelled honestly.
- [ ] The product film and poster return successfully; the film supports byte ranges and begins from the intended clean state.
- [ ] Keyboard focus, contrast, reduced motion, alt text, responsive overflow, and contact links were checked where relevant.

## Exceptions

List any deliberate deviation and link the implementation-plan decision that authorizes it. Use `None` when there is no exception.
